Amelia CSM: Theta wants to onboard theta-legal-14b (14B) for contract summarization. Must have HSM (BYOK), US-WEST-2 residency, and an evaluation on their 5k corpus. They asked for a pilot in ~3 weeks.

Rafael Sec: Clarify BYOK type: AWS CloudHSM vs customer appliance? We need vendor + certs to scope compliance flow.

Amelia CSM: They confirmed AWS CloudHSM. Also requested 90d audit log retention and KMS rotation policy.

Li Safety: We'll run PHI/PII extraction recall, hallucination on Q&A, and a redaction robustness test. Can they share 200 de-id docs for a holdout? If not, we'll synthesize.

Jon ML: Model format? If PT we can run staging evals; quantization later. Also need to know if model includes redaction hooks.

Amelia CSM: Provided: PT weights, finetuned on internal contracts, no built-in redaction.

Priya Eng: Rough rollout timeline if prioritized: security intake + HSM ticket (3 days), staging deploy + evals (5 days), canary ramp (4 days), pilot monitoring (7 days). Tight but feasible if CloudHSM onboarding goes smoothly. Need expected peak rps and p95 SLO.

Amelia CSM: Theta reports peak 35 rps, avg 9 rps, target p95 <350ms.

Priya Eng: Noted. We'll enable prefix KV caching and a canary fallback to redwood-legal-7b. Capacity plan looks OK for Dedicated medium GPU.

Rafael Sec: I'll collect required docs: SOC, network diagram, key rotation. Adding to ticket.

OpsBot: Created REDWOOD-ONBOARD-6421 for Theta HSM + security intake. https://redwood.example/tickets/REDWOOD-ONBOARD-6421

Amelia CSM: Renewal Aug 2026 – marking account health as "watch" until HSM cleared. Action items: Rafael collect security docs, Li draft eval checklist, Priya schedule staging, Jon prepare eval infra. I'll request de-id samples from Theta and confirm CloudHSM contact.

Priya Eng: I'll prep rollout doc and pair with infra on routing.

Amelia CSM: Thanks team — enablement call scheduled Tue 10am PT. Will update thread after call.
